items.html: How so? Netzach of Netzach, and Netzach of Chesed, and Netzach of Chokhma; and Hod of Hod, and Hod of Gevura, and Hod of Bina; and Yesod of Yesod, and Yesod of Tifferet, and Yesod of Daat. Behold, it has nine Sefirot at the time of the Ibur; and therefore the body of the fetus is small, even though it has nine Sefirot.
